results: 2. CSF 14-3-3 / RT-QuIC (prion): negative - excludes Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
3. history of the precipitating event: cardiac arrest with resuscitation; myoclonus and contractures developed afterwards
4. intrathecal baclofen trial: 50 mcg bolus on day 1, 75 mcg on day 2; Unified Myoclonus Rating Scale improved progressively with dose; sleep and positioning improved
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Lance–Adams syndrome (chronic post-hypoxic myoclonus with contractures/spasticity) caused by hypoxic-ischaemic brain injury following cardiac arrest and resuscitation.

Alternative 1: Acute post-hypoxic myoclonus/status epilepticus.

Alternative 2: Hypoxic brain injury–related dystonia and spasticity without Lance–Adams syndrome.

Alternative 3: Autoimmune stiff-person spectrum disorder.
